equipment_models_splitter_ck.name: equipment_models_splitter_ck
equipment_models_splitter_ck.value: "equipment_models"."kind" <> 'splitter' OR ("equipment_models"."splitter_inputs" BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND "equipment_models"."splitter_outputs" BETWEEN 2 AND 128)

terminals_kind_ck.name: terminals_kind_ck
terminals_kind_ck.value:
("terminals"."kind" = 'fiber_end' AND "terminals"."fiber_id" IS NOT NULL AND "terminals"."fiber_side" IS NOT NULL
            AND "terminals"."port_role" IS NULL AND "terminals"."port_no" IS NULL AND "terminals"."port_face" IS NULL)
       OR ("terminals"."kind" = 'port' AND "terminals"."equipment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "terminals"."port_role" IS NOT NULL AND "terminals"."port_no" >= 1
            AND "terminals"."fiber_id" IS NULL AND "terminals"."fiber_side" IS NULL
            AND (("terminals"."port_role" = 'adapter') = ("terminals"."port_face" IS NOT NULL)))
